packageRules.description: The ESLint/angular-eslint/typescript-eslint plugin ecosystem eslint-config wraps is declared as regular `dependencies` there (consumers need it at runtime), not `devDependencies` — the generic devDependencies group above doesn't cover it. A version mismatch between e.g. `eslint` and `eslint-plugin-react` breaks eslint-config outright, so every update coming from this one package.json (its own devDependencies too, incl. the @angular/core/rxjs test fixtures) is grouped into a single PR instead of racing each other.
